description: Members. Publish one of your OneWriter drafts as a post on your Underground wall (or in a room you can post in), as yourself. It goes through the site's own posting rules and safety filter and is seen by members on the Underground; no public web page is made and nothing is emailed. Posts run up to 1,000 characters, so a longer draft is refused (OneWriter can download it as Markdown or HTML). At most 10 a day. Shows a preview of the exact text first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to post.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview. true writes it.

preview_token.description: The preview_token the preview returned. Needed with confirm true.

room.description: Post in this room instead of the main wall.

name: publish_draft
title: Publish a draft to the Underground
